import QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Ports

/-! Explicit ownership-structure conversions, with checked basis bijections.
Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
These nodes change types/owner counts explicitly. They never authorize an
implicit coercion, an arbitrary gate equation or an external evidence handle. -/

namespace QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Structural
open Artifact

def swapped (interface : Interface) : Interface := ⟨interface.outputs,interface.inputs⟩

def types (side : Side) : Array Basis := side.quantum.map QuantumPort.basis

def one (side : Side) (basis : Basis) : Bool := types side == #[basis]

/-- Split only the immediate fields. Flattening a nested field changes this
prefix tree and is rejected even when the number of wires is unchanged. -/
def splitTuple (interface : Interface) : Bool :=
  let fields := interface.outputs.quantum
  2 ≤ fields.size && fields.size ≤ 64 &&
  one interface.inputs (fields.foldl (fun tree field => tree ++ field.basis) #[.tuple fields.size]) &&
  wires interface.inputs == wires interface.outputs

def takeBit (interface : Interface) (width position : Nat) : Bool :=
  one interface.inputs #[.bits width] &&
  types interface.outputs == #[#[.bit],#[.bits (width - 1)]] &&
  (do
    let source ← interface.inputs.quantum[0]?
    let selected ← interface.outputs.quantum[0]?
    let remainder ← interface.outputs.quantum[1]?
    let axis ← source.axes[position]?
    return selected.axes == #[axis] &&
      remainder.axes == ((source.axes.toList.take position) ++
        (source.axes.toList.drop (position + 1))).toArray).getD false

def bitToBits (interface : Interface) : Bool :=
  one interface.inputs #[.bit] && one interface.outputs #[.bits 1] &&
    wires interface.inputs == wires interface.outputs

def packEmpty (interface : Interface) (basis : Basis) : Bool :=
  interface.inputs.quantum.isEmpty && one interface.outputs basis

/-- Every operation has a closed, explicit owner transition. No frame is
silently inferred: frames are composed by checked tensor/call nodes. -/
def shape (operation : StructuralOp) (interface : Interface) : Bool := match operation with
  | .takeBit width position => takeBit interface width position
  | .putBit width position => takeBit (swapped interface) width position
  | .splitTuple => splitTuple interface
  | .joinTuple => splitTuple (swapped interface)
  | .bitToBits => bitToBits interface
  | .bitsToBit => bitToBits (swapped interface)
  | .packUnit => packEmpty interface #[.unit]
  | .unpackUnit => packEmpty (swapped interface) #[.unit]
  | .packEmptyBits => packEmpty interface #[.bits 0]
  | .unpackEmptyBits => packEmpty (swapped interface) #[.bits 0]

/-- Whole old owners are consumed. New owners are distinct and fresh; zero-wire
owners obey this rule just like owners with nonempty axis arrays. -/
def fresh (interface : Interface) : Bool :=
  interface.outputs.quantum.all (fun output =>
    !interface.inputs.quantum.any (fun input => input.owner == output.owner))

/-- Output basis positions select actual input wires, in declared order.
Local labels need not be contiguous or small positional indices. -/
def axisMap (interface : Interface) : List Nat :=
  let inputs := (wires interface.inputs).toList
  (wires interface.outputs).toList.map (fun axis => inputs.findIdx (· == axis))

def inverseAxes (interface : Interface) : List Nat :=
  Ports.inverse (wires interface.inputs).size (axisMap interface).toArray

def valid (operation : StructuralOp) (interface : Interface) : Bool :=
  operation.bounded && interface.valid &&
  interface.inputs.classical.isEmpty && interface.outputs.classical.isEmpty &&
  fresh interface && shape operation interface &&
  decide (Layout.Permutation (wires interface.inputs).size
    (axisMap interface) (inverseAxes interface))

/-- Charge header array sizes before traversal, then charge type/axis scans,
uniqueness, routing lookup and both inverse laws before performing them. -/
def scanCharge (interface : Interface) : Nat := 8 * (1 + interface.scan)^2

def workCharge (interface : Interface) : Nat :=
  scanCharge interface + 16 * (1 + interface.charge) +
    8 * (1 + Ports.wireCount interface.inputs + Ports.wireCount interface.outputs)^2

structure Checked where
  visits : Nat
  deriving Repr

def check (operation : StructuralOp) (interface : Interface) (remaining : Nat) : Except Error Checked :=
  if remaining > 2000000 || scanCharge interface > remaining then .error .limit
  else if workCharge interface > remaining then .error .limit
  else if !valid operation interface then .error .invalidIr
  else .ok ⟨workCharge interface⟩

theorem check_conditions (operation : StructuralOp) (interface : Interface) (remaining : Nat)
    (checked : Checked) (accepted : check operation interface remaining = .ok checked) :
    checked.visits = workCharge interface ∧ checked.visits ≤ remaining ∧
    remaining ≤ 2000000 ∧ valid operation interface = true := by
  unfold check at accepted
  split at accepted
  next invalid => contradiction
  next bounded =>
    split at accepted
    next invalid => contradiction
    next enough =>
      split at accepted
      next invalid => contradiction
      next correct =>
        cases Except.ok.inj accepted
        have limits : remaining ≤ 2000000 ∧ scanCharge interface ≤ remaining := by
          simpa only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, not_or, Nat.not_lt] using bounded
        exact ⟨rfl, Nat.le_of_not_gt enough, limits.1, by simpa using correct⟩

theorem check_shape (operation : StructuralOp) (interface : Interface) (remaining : Nat)
    (checked : Checked) (accepted : check operation interface remaining = .ok checked) :
    operation.bounded = true ∧ interface.valid = true ∧
    interface.inputs.classical.isEmpty = true ∧ interface.outputs.classical.isEmpty = true ∧
    fresh interface = true ∧ shape operation interface = true := by
  have h := (check_conditions operation interface remaining checked accepted).2.2.2
  simp only [valid, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
  exact ⟨h.1.1.1.1.1.1,h.1.1.1.1.1.2,h.1.1.1.1.2,h.1.1.1.2,h.1.1.2,h.1.2⟩

theorem check_axes (operation : StructuralOp) (interface : Interface) (remaining : Nat)
    (checked : Checked) (accepted : check operation interface remaining = .ok checked) :
    Layout.Permutation (wires interface.inputs).size (axisMap interface) (inverseAxes interface) := by
  have h := (check_conditions operation interface remaining checked accepted).2.2.2
  simp only [valid, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  exact h.2

/-- Reindex only the quantum basis. Coefficients (including their phase) and an
arbitrary reference coordinate remain unchanged, in both inverse directions. -/
theorem check_reference_round_trips (operation : StructuralOp) (interface : Interface) (remaining : Nat)
    (checked : Checked) (accepted : check operation interface remaining = .ok checked) {R C : Type}
    (amplitude : (Fin (wires interface.inputs).size → Bool) → R → C) :
    let h := check_axes operation interface remaining checked accepted
    (fun bits reference => amplitude
      (Layout.reindex (axisMap interface) h.forwardBound
        (Layout.reindex (inverseAxes interface) h.backwardBound bits)) reference) = amplitude ∧
    (fun bits reference => amplitude
      (Layout.reindex (inverseAxes interface) h.backwardBound
        (Layout.reindex (axisMap interface) h.forwardBound bits)) reference) = amplitude := by
  dsimp
  constructor
  · funext bits reference
    rw [Layout.reindex_round_trip (check_axes operation interface remaining checked accepted)]
  · funext bits reference
    rw [Layout.reindex_reverse_round_trip (check_axes operation interface remaining checked accepted)]

end QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Structural
